utility: Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc.
structure_note: Delivery charges are the sum of the maximum kW in each of three periods multiplied by that period's rate. This is a stacked multi-period demand tariff, not an energy (per kWh) tariff.
component_support: PARTIAL. The component's demand_rate_ input applies a single $/kW to the monthly peak. It does not stack three coincident-period peaks. Use it as a first-order screen only, or extend the script. See README, Limitations.
source_transcription_note: The Con Edison page lists the winter 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. value with a per kWh unit. Given the column heading and the other values, this is almost certainly a typo for per kW. Verify against the tariff (PSC No. 10, SC 9) before use.
